call get_nearest_airport_by_city({"location":"Rivermist"}) -> result contains e.g., {"airport_code": "..."}.

Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=code1, travel_to=code2, travel_date="2024-12-01", travel_class="first".

Thus we need to chain calls. According to policy, we cannot combine multiple arguments across different calls. So we'll make separate calls sequentially.

Let's proceed.
